satisfied_inclusion_points: The full text describes Visual Narrator, an NLP-based method to extract conceptual models from user stories (natural language).
The paper provides a concrete extraction method (Algorithm 1: DERIVECM) and an empirical evaluation on two data sets (WebCompany and CMSCompany).
It outlines an architecture and heuristics (e.g., C1–C4, R2; Processor/Constructor) and reports results from two case studies.
The full text is in English, presents original research, and focuses on NLP-enabled process extraction from natural language requirements.
evidence_highlights: Algorithm 1 DERIVECM builds a conceptual model by mining user stories using NLP heuristics.
The approach uses a spaCy-based NLP pipeline and outputs OWL representations.
Evaluation reports precision/recall metrics for concepts and relationships on two datasets (WebCompany, CMSCompany).
stage2_review.decision_rationale: The full text directly satisfies the Stage 2 inclusion criteria and does not trigger any exclusion criterion.

evidence_highlights: Section titled 'Process Extraction from Text via In-Context Learning' details the extraction approach and prompts.

Targets include activities, participants, the performs relation, and the directly follows relation, with precision/recall/F1 metrics.
